title: Nhận định Mỹ vs Úc — World Cup 2026

scenes.subjectHint: Hook split-frame — Pulisic (Mỹ) trái vs Irankunda (Úc) phải; ghép từ hook-1 + hook-2
scenes.prompt: Vertical 9:16 split-frame football poster artwork showing a World Cup 2026 Group D matchup. Left half: Christian Pulisic, the American winger and captain for the United States national team, in a white USA home kit with the US Soccer crest clearly visible on the chest and the captain's armband, intense focused hero pose. Behind him, a stylized navy-white-and-red USA graphic backdrop with a huge faint US Soccer crest watermark and radiating light rays. Right half: Nestory Irankunda, the young Australian winger for the Australia Socceroos national team, in a gold-and-green Australia home kit with the Football Australia crest clearly visible on the chest, mirroring driving hero pose. Behind him, a stylized green-and-gold graphic backdrop with a huge faint Socceroos crest watermark and radiating light rays. Down the centre seam: a diagonal lightning-burst slash separator with dramatic energy glow, the FIFA World Cup trophy glowing as a stylized graphic accent between them. Vibrant saturated palette per side, very high contrast, glossy graphic-design finish. Stylized like a World Cup matchday rivalry promotional poster. Both national-team crests visible on the jerseys, no on-image text or captions, no scoreboard graphics.
